title: Schedule a disposable user cron job
goal: Observe and remove one named user cron job.
challenge: Schedule only a fresh disposable user job. Prove actual cron execution/private output, then remove future scheduling without altering other crontabs.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-s3 && ! getent group ll-s3 && test ! -e /home/ll-s3 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-s3

printf '%s
' '#!/bin/bash' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin 'umask 077' '[ "$(id -un)" = ll-s3 ] || exit 2' 'cd /home/ll-s3 || exit 3' 'printf "user=%s
" "$(id -un)" > report.txt &&' 'printf "stamp=%s
" "$(date -Is)" >> report.txt' | sudo tee /home/ll-s3/job.sh > /dev/null && sudo chown ll-s3:ll-s3 /home/ll-s3/job.sh && sudo chmod 0700 /home/ll-s3/job.sh

sudo test ! -e /var/spool/cron/crontabs/ll-s3 && printf '%s\n' 'MAILTO=""' 'SHELL=/bin/sh' 'PATH=/usr/bin:/bin' '* * * * * umask 077; /usr/bin/timeout -k 1s 5s /home/ll-s3/job.sh > /home/ll-s3/stdout.txt 2> /home/ll-s3/error.txt; echo $? > /home/ll-s3/status.txt' | sudo crontab -u ll-s3 -
steps.explanation: Fresh spool guard; five fields then command, no username column.

steps.command: sudo crontab -u ll-s3 -l; end=$((SECONDS+85)); until sudo test -s /home/ll-s3/report.txt; do test "$SECONDS" -lt "$end" || break; sleep 1; done; sudo runuser -u ll-s3 -- cat /home/ll-s3/report.txt; sudo stat -c "%U:%G %a %s" /home/ll-s3/report.txt
steps.explanation: Bounded85-second wait for a real minute boundary; no clock changes.
steps.expected: Actual account-owned report; absence is failure.

steps.command: sudo crontab -u ll-s3 -r; sudo crontab -u ll-s3 -l
steps.explanation: Remove only this practice account crontab.
steps.expected: No entry; already-running work is not killed.

hints: User crontab has no username column.
Raw unescaped percent in cron has special stdin semantics: keep formats in the script.
Cron does not universally serialize jobs; removal prevents future starts only.
review: Exact entry, real report/ownership and removal.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 107.2 partial cron/systemd timers; 105.2/108.2 reinforcement; self-reviewed, unscored. No at or full objective coverage.
